name: Endpoint request sample
how_to_use: Decode png_base64 to a file (for example: base64 -d frame.b64 > frame.png) and send it to the frame translation endpoint with the unsupported_request parameters. The image is a 1x1 blank PNG: the request must be rejected on the language before any provider sees the image.

records.expected: A clear rejection naming the unsupported language; no recognition or translation provider call in the backend log.
